ارتشفا (form VIII)
# اِرْتَشَفَا (irtašafā) /ir.ta.ʃa.faː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِرْتَشَفَ (irtašafa)
# اُرْتُشِفَا (urtušifā) /ur.tu.ʃi.faː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِرْتَشَفَ (irtašafa)
# اِرْتَشِفَا (irtašifā) /ir.ta.ʃi.faː/: second-person dual imperative of اِرْتَشَفَ (irtašafa)
